metadata.name: Saltmarsh Harbor
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A working fishing harbour on a grey, gull-loud morning (Style Pack 11: Coastal Harbor). The Embers hold the net sheds and the warehouse in the south-west of the town; the Tide hold the end of the east mole, its warehouse and crane. Between them the harbour basin: along the quay and through the fish market and the harbour arch, out along the pier to the pier head in the breakwater, over the boardwalk to the lighthouse and along the breakwater to the mole, or straight across the water on a jet ski or swimming, out by the sea wall steps, the slipway, the beach or a ladder up the quay. Snipe from the lighthouse gallery or the crane, fight room to room through the warehouses and net lofts, run their roofs.
